## 4. What the physical implementation requires

The formula \(\Gamma_C=\operatorname{Ad}_C\circ E\) is not permission to apply \(C\) deterministically to an existing channel output. Generally \(C^*C\npreceq I\).

The valid device construction uses the complete channel description. If \(K_\alpha\) are Kraus operators for \(E\), the new channel has Kraus operators
\[
\widetilde K_\alpha=CK_\alpha,
\qquad
\sum_\alpha\widetilde K_\alpha^*\widetilde K_\alpha=I_a.
\]
These give an actual Stinespring isometry
\[
V|\psi\rangle
=\sum_\alpha\widetilde K_\alpha|\psi\rangle\otimes|\alpha\rangle,
\]
and the actual complementary channel follows from
\[
\Gamma_C^c(X)_{\alpha\beta}
=\operatorname{Tr}\!\left(
\widetilde K_\alpha X\widetilde K_\beta^*
\right).
\]

The compiler emits this data. On the preserved capacity-separating fixture, it produced an explicit rational greatest channel with input dimension \(2\), output dimension \(8\), and an environment of dimension \(16\), together with its complement and a deterministic simulator for the high channel.

### Recovery from an existing device has a paid success probability

For a class member \(\Phi\) and target \(\Psi\), let
\[
L\Phi=\Psi,\qquad K=L^*(I).
\]
Choose a rational \(p>0\) with \(pK\preceq I\); for example,
\[
p=\frac1{\operatorname{Tr}K}.
\]
Then
\[
\mathcal S=pL,\qquad
\mathcal F(Y)=\operatorname{Tr}[(I-pK)Y]|\perp\rangle\langle\perp|
\]
form a physical success/failure instrument.

For every referenced input,
\[
(\mathcal S\otimes\mathrm{id})(\Phi\otimes\mathrm{id})(\rho)
=p(\Psi\otimes\mathrm{id})(\rho).
\]
The success probability is independent of the input. Both branches have explicit Kraus realizations, and their environments are included.

Consequently, an \(n\)-use adaptive target protocol has an exact all-success simulation with probability \(p^n\). For an experiment whose initial state can be prepared afresh, the fixed-block convention costs
\[
\frac{n}{p^n}
\]
expected primitive channel uses per accepted block, plus its classical communication.

An unknown input can be destroyed by failure. It cannot generally be retried. This distinction remains part of the theorem.

## 5. What the geometry preserves operationally

The greatest representative gives an attained ceiling for every capacity monotone under output processing:
\[
Q(F)\le Q(\Gamma_0)
\quad\text{for every }F\text{ in the class}.
\]
